verdict: B / Keep (reference only, not production candidate)
lesson: Gentle DD (15/35) vs tight DD (10/25) outcome depends on base alpha strength. STR_1527 M25+V24 has zero IC and zero FF5 alpha — tight DD destroyed too much of the thin return stream (CAGR 5.76% vs 7.1%, SR 0.373 vs 0.404). Gentle DD wins on 6/7 metrics for weak-alpha strategies. This REVERSES the STR_1509 finding where tight DD was better (that strategy had real alpha). Generalized rule: DD tightness should scale with base alpha quality. Strong alpha tolerates tight DD; weak alpha needs gentle DD or no DD at all. Both variants rescued base F(MDD 61.9%) to B but 43% MDD still far from 25% target.
meta_insight: DD overlay tightness is not monotonic — optimal tightness is a function of base alpha strength
